scope: Owner request 2026-09-23 ("Remove options bug"): remove the hidden three-second OPTIONS hold on the start menu, which silently replaced the live save with the pre-New-Game archive and reloaded the scene with no confirmation, voice or progress cue. A child who kept holding OPTIONS because nothing appeared to happen could lose all progress made since a New Game. OPTIONS now only opens the settings sheet. The archive file and the tested SaveState.restore_new_game_archive() primitive are kept; the now-unused main.gd wrapper is removed and BACKUP.md documents the off-device adb restore instead of the removed gesture. No save keys, protected assets, New Game safeguards or other menu behaviour change.
no_findings_reason: The hold-to-restore gesture is not in the finding register. It was identified by the 2026-09-22 repository health review and removed on direct owner instruction. MA-SAVE-001 concerns unpersisted castle scratch state and is unrelated; no existing MA-* record is repaired or changed.
